_about: Reader-visible text for the game. Written by the agent; listed in SECOND-ORDER.md for Sam to read. Follows TONE.md.
title: CHUM MAY CRY
tagline: The wall has fallen. Get out of the city.
start_note: A controller works from its first press. Sound starts after a click or a key: browsers do not let a controller start it.
menu.controls: Keyboard and mouse, or plug in a PlayStation or Xbox controller.
arena1.title: The park above the lake
arena1.c1: The wall fell at dawn. The Defence Force is gone, and the colony is leaving the city.
arena1.c2: Your utility tool is in your hand: axe, pick and blade. Fast things slow near the fauna, so everyone fights up close.
arena1.c3: Something bright moves between the trees.
arena2.title: The overlook
arena2.c1: A colonist lies by the path, badly hurt.
arena2.c2: "They hunt in threes. Hold the ability button and strike, and spin: it stops all of them at once."
arena2.c3: You have learned the Whirlwind Strike.
arena3.title: The lakeside steps
arena3.c1: A guard waves you down toward the water.
arena3.c2: "That big one is badly hurt and will not fight back. Light, heavy, light, light, heavy, then launch it."
arena4.title: The north gate
arena4.c1: The last carts of the colony roll toward the north gate.
arena4.c2: A pack has found the road: four dogs and a large one, all at once.
arena4.c3: Hold the gate until the carts are through.
arena5.title: The reed bank
arena5.c1: Past the gate the road follows the lake through the reeds.
arena5.c2: Something violet watches from the far bank, and two young dogs run ahead of it.
arena5.c3: It spits bolts of light and runs when you come close. Catch it, and one blow will stagger it.
arena6.title: The causeway
arena6.c1: The carts reach the causeway as night falls.
arena6.c2: The violet caster is back, and two large dogs walk with it.
arena6.c3: These two will not wait their turn. Keep moving.
sandbox.title: Sandbox
won.last: The last fight so far is done. More of the city waits.
lost: You fell. The fight starts again from the checkpoint.
hint: Press the button shown to do the move.
strip.again: The string broke. Start again with a light attack.
no_webgl: This page needs WebGL 2. Try another browser.
arena7.title: The quarry road
arena7.c1: Past the causeway the road climbs through an old quarry.
arena7.c2: Two blocks of slate stand in the cut. They are not stones: they slide to meet you, fists first.
arena7.c3: Single blows will not move them. Keep a string going until their guard breaks, then launch them.
arena8.title: The ridge
arena8.c1: Night falls on the ridge above the quarry.
arena8.c2: Something tall walks the skyline on bent legs, a blade where its right hand should be.
arena8.c3: Two of them, and a brute behind. Break each guard with a full string, and use the Dash Strike to close the gap.
story.tag: The wall has fallen. Fight your way out of the city, one stop at a time. Any fight can be played again.
story.map: The colony's road out of the city
story.play_all: Play the story from the start
arena9.title: The pumphouse
arena9.c1: Over the ridge the road drops to the lake and an old pumphouse.
arena9.c2: A brute guards the door. Two smaller stalkers circle it, quick and light, and a caster waits further back.
arena9.c3: A scout's guard breaks to a short string. Clear them fast, then turn on the brute.
arena10.title: The pier
arena10.c1: The pier runs out over the water toward the gasworks.
arena10.c2: Something heavy blocks it: a brute in rust plate, bigger than the others, with two large dogs at its side.
arena10.c3: Its guard holds through a plain string. Put a Dash Strike or a Cleave in the string to break it. Both dogs can attack at once.
arena11.title: The gasworks
arena11.c1: The gasworks stand at the end of the shore, the city lit up across the water.
arena11.c2: Everything left on the road is waiting here.
arena11.c3: A heavy brute, two scouts and a caster. Take the caster first if you can reach it, then the scouts, and save the brute for last.
music.label: Music
music.missing: No music track in this build.
drill.footwork.title: Footwork
drill.footwork.c1: Walk, run and jump: the three ways to move.
drill.lock.title: Lock-on
drill.lock.c1: Lock-on keeps the camera and your attacks on one enemy. Turn it off and on, then switch between enemies.
drill.lights.title: Light string
drill.lights.c1: Four light attacks in a row is the most you get before a short rest.
drill.heavies.title: Heavy string
drill.heavies.c1: Three heavy attacks in a row. Heavies are slow, and have super armor: a hit will not stop them.
drill.first.title: The first string
drill.first.c1: Light, heavy, light, light, heavy: the last two are the Spin Slash and the Crescent.
drill.launch.title: Launcher
drill.launch.c1: A hit stuns; the launcher lifts a stunned enemy into the air.
drill.first_launch.title: Alien Slayer
drill.first_launch.c1: End the first string with the launcher: Alien Slayer, ending in the Skybreaker.
drill.pick.title: Pick and Axe
drill.pick.c1: Light, light, heavy, heavy: the Hook, then the Cleave.
drill.whirl.title: Whirlwind Strike
drill.whirl.c1: When a dog leaps, the Whirlwind Strike knocks it down. It costs stamina.
drill.dash.title: Dash Strike
drill.dash.c1: The Dash Strike crosses 8 m in a blink and has super armor.
drill.air_string.title: Air string
drill.air_string.c1: Launch, jump after it, and keep hitting: each air hit holds you both up.
drill.air_heavy.title: Air heavies
drill.air_heavy.c1: Two heavy attacks in the air.
drill.air_slam.title: Air slam
drill.air_slam.c1: The launcher in the air slams the enemy into the ground.
drill.updraft.title: Updraft
drill.updraft.c1: In the air, the Updraft lifts you both again, once a jump, and the air string starts over.
drill.air_chain.title: Holding an air combo
drill.air_chain.c1: Keep an enemy up as long as you can: lights, the Updraft, more lights, a heavy and the slam.
drill.grab_toss.title: Grab and throw
drill.grab_toss.c1: Grab a stunned enemy; light throws it where you point.
drill.grab_slam.title: Grab and slam
drill.grab_slam.c1: Holding an enemy, heavy slams it into the ground.
drill.grab_up.title: Grab and toss up
drill.grab_up.c1: Holding an enemy, the launcher tosses it up: jump after it.
drill.grab_tap.title: Grab with a tap
drill.grab_tap.c1: A tap of the ability button on its own grabs too.
drill.air_grab.title: Air grab
drill.air_grab.c1: In the air you can grab an enemy you are juggling, then slam it down.
drill.armor.title: Super armor
drill.armor.c1: Meet a leaping dog with a heavy: super armor takes the bite and the heavy lands.
drill.guard.title: Guard break
drill.guard.c1: A brute's guard breaks only to a string: Pick and Axe breaks it, then launch.
drill.full_chain.title: Ground, air, ground
drill.full_chain.c1: The whole chain: two lights and the launcher, an air string with the Updraft, the slam, then grab and slam.
action.grab_tap: Grab with a tap, nothing else held
action.slam_throw: Heavy while holding: slam it down
action.toss_up: Launcher while holding: toss it up
drill.again: The moment passed: from the start of the chain.
arena12.title: The hive
arena12.c1: Past the gasworks the shore ends at a hive of glass and wire.
arena12.c2: Its warden comes out alone. It is faster than the others, and it watches your blade.
arena12.c3: Kick off it when it leaps. Strike when it rests.
drill.kick.title: Kick off
drill.kick.c1: L1 or Q with the launcher kicks off an enemy and carries you back: room to breathe.
drill.kick_leap.title: Kick through a leap
drill.kick_leap.c1: Kick a leaping dog: the kick breaks its leap, and its first moments dodge the bite.
drill.air_kick.title: Air kick
drill.air_kick.c1: In the air, kick off the enemy you are juggling: it hops you up and gives you a jump back.
drill.kick_chain.title: Kick and jump again
drill.kick_chain.c1: Every air kick gives your jump back: kick, jump, kick, jump, and you are still up there to strike.
action.dive: Dive kick at your target, in the air
action.parry: Parry a blow as it lands
arena13.title: The brood pit
arena13.c1: Under the hive the floor gives way to a pit, and something with four arms climbs out of it.
arena13.c2: It catches a launcher in its claws and throws you back. Parry its claws to wear its guard down.
arena13.c3: When it reels, grab it and toss it up. Only a throw puts it in the air.
drill.parry.title: Parry
drill.parry.c1: Parry as the dog's leap comes down: the bite is turned aside and the dog is stunned, open to your next strike.
drill.beast.title: Throw the beast
drill.dive.title: Dive kick
drill.dive.c1: Jump, and at the top dive kick at the enemy you are locked on to.
drill.dive_down.title: Dive kick down
drill.dive_down.c1: Launch the enemy, follow it up, and dive kick it back down into the ground.
drill.dive_chain.title: Dive kick and Updraft
drill.dive_chain.c1: Spend your Updraft, dive kick the enemy, then air kick off it: the Updraft comes back. Jump and use it again.
drill.beast.c1: The beast catches a launcher. Parry it twice to break its guard, then grab it and toss it up.
arena14.title: The cranes
arena14.c1: Out of the hive the road drops to the docks, where the cranes stand over the water.
arena14.c2: Six young dogs close in a ring around you, and their leader waits behind them.
arena14.c3: Break the ring before the leader joins it.
arena15.title: The cold store
arena15.c1: Between the cold stores two young beasts guard the yard.
arena15.c2: A storm caster sits at the far end, and its bolts come fast.
arena15.c3: The young beasts still catch a launcher: parry, grab and throw.
arena16.title: The dry dock
arena16.c1: In the dry dock an iron brute blocks the way ahead.
arena16.c2: Two stalkers come at you from either side.
arena16.c3: The iron brute's guard is the hardest yet: parry it, or throw a body into it.
arena17.title: The slipway
arena17.c1: An old beast climbs out of the water onto the slipway.
arena17.c2: Two young dogs come up behind you.
arena17.c3: Its claws are heavy, and it catches any launcher. Wear its guard down.
arena18.title: The sea wall
arena18.c1: Three scouts hold the sea wall in a line.
arena18.c2: Two storm casters stand far back on either side.
arena18.c3: Two may strike at once. Take the casters when you can.
arena19.title: The ferry ramp
arena19.c1: On the ferry ramp two pack leaders flank a heavy brute.
arena19.c2: A young beast comes up from behind.
arena19.c3: The leaders are quick, and a light hit will not stop them.
arena20.title: The lighthouse
arena20.c1: At the end of the docks a second warden waits at the lighthouse.
arena20.c2: Two young beasts come with it.
arena21.title: The lamp room
arena21.c1: At the top of the lighthouse the keeper of the lamp turns to face you.
arena21.c2: It strikes five times in a row. Parry every strike, in order, and it breaks open.
arena21.c3: Watch its stance. Glowing dots turn back the launcher, purple smoke turns back light attacks, red embers turn back heavy attacks.
